note: The league's weekly group parlay. ONE file for the season, APPENDED to — unlike season/current.json, which is overwritten, because the point of this tab is the running record. It ships with an empty `weeks` array so an unstarted season still answers 200 and a 404 can be reported as a broken deploy rather than as business as usual. `open` names the week picks are being taken for ({k, l}); leave it out and picks open for the week after the newest ticket, which is derivable and needs no edit — it only has to be stated for the first week of a season. It is honoured ONLY while it is ahead of the newest ticket: once a week is published, a stale `open` sitting on or behind it is ignored and the next week opens by itself, so it can never offer picks at games that have kicked off. Each week: `k` the NFL week (unique), `l` its label, `d` the date the ticket was placed, `stake` the total on it in dollars (optional), `book` where it was placed (optional), and `legs` — one per manager: `m` the manager code, `p` the pick as it reads on the slip, `o` the American odds, `r` the result ('W' won, 'L' lost, 'P' push, omitted = not settled yet). NOTHING derived is stored: the combined price, the payout, the records and the hit rates are all worked out from these legs when the page loads, so a corrected leg corrects every number on the tab. `sync` is OPTIONAL and is the whole shared-picks feature: a Firebase Realtime Database URL (https, no path, no trailing slash) that the app writes each pick to and reads everybody's from. Leave it blank and the tab behaves exactly as it did before it existed — picks travel through the group chat — so turning it on and off is this one line and no version bump. It is NOT a credential: the repo is public, so the URL is public, and the app treats every row in the store as untrusted input.
